740033002.text: Huh. Y'know, Paimon thought that she hadn't fully woken up yet... But haven't these things happened before?

740030303.text: Haha. That name does fit our adventure up till now, huh?

740030305.text: This is the center of the world. The castle where the dragon lurks, the tower that imprisons the Princess. Sometimes, it is the lost Ancient City of Ys. Sometimes, Arcadia. At times, it is even golden Hyperborea.

740030306.text: Here, many untrodden realms have been conquered. Here, many heroes have defeated evil dragons.

740030307.text: This is a place that brims with magic, and I was never really able to understand it. Children could see, through a stone wall, the imaginary griffins that whirl freely in the distant cloud-filled skies.

740030308.text: These four pools would, in different adventure tales, be the four seas, and sometimes the four cardinal realms of the world.

740030309.text: I could not understand these things either, but to accompany the children on their adventures, I played all sorts of roles.

740030310.text: Are these more of those suddenly-emerging memories?

740030313.text: I don't know. I feel very strange. These memories are so beautiful, but terrifying, too.

740030314.text: Look, there, atop that small fountain. That is the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz.

740030315.text: Is it really? It looks, uh, kinda cheap.

740030601.text: Actually, why is there a Bubble Formation here too? Was this meant to prevent invaders from kidnapping the Princess?

740030603.text: Also, we ran into some enemies earlier. Didn't you say that when Princess Lyris gave you her treasure, the tower stagnated, and even Narcissus could not enter?

740030604.text: There's... a lot of stuff here that doesn't make sense. What's going on?

740030605.text: I don't know either. I never thought about what would happen after we entered the tower.

740030606.text: Also, this place feels very strange. I don't understand. I should never have been here before, but I find myself... recalling, feeling many things.

740030607.text: Do you two not feel it?

740030611.text: Well, do you know what place this is, Ann?

740030612.text: This was the assembly hall of the Narzissenkreuz Institute. The children would study here normally. I remember now. This was a lovely place. There was no sunlight, but it was always lively here.

740030613.text: The children were all of different dimensions — some of them as different as the two of you. But here, they would study together, listen to tales of the Hydro Archon... and to tales older still.

740030615.text: I mean that some children were very small, and some were somewhat larger.

740030616.text: Hey now! Paimon might be small, but she's got a big heart!

740030617.text: A—Anyway... What about the Princess? Was she a child, too? Would the children hear stories about her?

740030620.text: Why does Paimon get the feeling that the story's started drifting away from the Princess ever since we teleported here?

740030621.text: No, this place must have something to do with her.

740030622.text: We must be able to find her at the end of this road. She will be happy to see us.

740030623.text: Well, you're the local. Paimon trusts you!

740030801.text: Hehe, finally! The Holy Blade is ours!

740030901.text: It doesn't look like much, but once its powers are awakened, it will become a destructive and invincible weapon!

740030902.text: #How is it, {NICKNAME}? Can you feel its power?

740030906.text: Wh—What? C'mon, you had Paimon going there...

740030909.text: Come to think of it, Ann, you did mention that the Holy Blade was originally a wooden sword that kids played with...

740030910.text: That's right. When the young heroes from the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team would pick this sword up, they would become able to defeat all foes in their tale.

740030911.text: ...Well, let's just take this sword, shall we? Who knows, it might come in handy later — and if not, we can take it as a souvenir.

740034202.text: Wait a minute. Is it just that Paimon hasn't fully woken up yet, or is it déjà vu? Haven't these things already happened before?

740031201.text: Looks like the path leads downward rather than forward...

740031202.text: This is a really long descent...

740031204.text: #Don't worry, Ann. {NICKNAME}'s really reliable — and really good with a wind glider, too!

740031205.text: But... We don't know what will happen next...

740031206.text: Well, Princess Lyris waits at the end of this path.

740031209.text: Yes! That has to be true. Apart from saving the Princess... apart from that one wish, I have nothing at all. I'll do anything to fulfill it!

740031213.text: Believe in me and Paimon. Let's go.

740031302.text: This is a really long descent...

740031304.text: #Don't worry, Ann. {NICKNAME}'s really reliable — and really good with a wind glider, too!

740031305.text: Ah, Paimon knows. You're worried about what might come afterward, right? Well, don't be!

740031306.text: #A real adventure is not only filled with challenges, but also with unknowns. The most important thing is to come back from completing those challenges and unknowns in one piece, and gain something in the end as well. Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?

740031310.text: #I believe in you, Knight {NICKNAME}, and in Paimon. You are wise and powerful... and you are also kind people.

740031311.text: And ding ding ding, we have a winner! In that case, let's go. "Ad astra abyssosque," as Katheryne always says!

740031501.text: Paimon's... kinda... dizzy. There are so many books here...

740031601.text: Hmm... Paimon feels like something should happen right about now...

740031602.text: I feel uneasy too... And I've been... frightened, ever since we came down here.

740031603.text: #No need to worry. {NICKNAME} will protect us no matter what, right?

740031605.text: #Hey! C'mon, you've beaten dragons, {NICKNAME}! Have more faith in yourself!

740031607.text: Yes. I believe in the two of you. I just... don't know what we will encounter later...

740031608.text: We'll take anything as it comes!

740031609.text: #Still, best to be prepared, {NICKNAME}. We might be in for a battle with Narcissus, for all we know!

740031701.text: "Someone" wants this tale of adventure to never end.

740031703.text: Huh. You know what? Paimon thought that she hadn't fully woken up yet... But haven't these things happened before?

740031707.text: Princess Lyris waits at the end of this path.

740031708.text: Ooh, Paimon knows! The last time we were here, you said "On the other hand, we'll be able to leave as long as we find the end of the road," didn't you?

740031709.text: Hmm... Then there must be a way!

740031801.text: There will be another adventure, and another, and another one after that.

740031803.text: So... Even though the Princess is waiting for us at the end of this road, it's just a bunch of connected loops with no real end?

740031805.text: We'll be able to leave as long as we find the end of the road.

740031808.text: I'm sorry. I don't know. I don't know anything about what happens after this...

740031809.text: Then let's take stock real quick.

740031812.text: Eh? You're asking Paimon? Uh, hold on a moment...

740031813.text: First, the paths here have been connected such that they form a ring, right? In that case, there'd be no getting out...

740031814.text: Except that we were able to get on these paths, so there should be a way off them. There has to be a point from which we can break through.

740031815.text: Next, we saw that... super powerful sword, or something.

740031816.text: Yes, the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz.

740031817.text: It should be a key item in some way...

740031818.text: And why do you think that?

740031819.text: Well, it looks like a wooden sword, but it was inside a protective barrier. Would all that trouble be necessary if it wasn't important?

740031820.text: So, Paimon thinks that we need to get that sword!

740031821.text: Was there any other notable thing?

740031822.text: Hmm... Paimon can't think of anything at the moment...

740031823.text: But that said, this tile sticks out like a sore thumb, doesn't it?

740031824.text: Paimon didn't just make that one up, by the way! When we passed this way before, it did feel weird how this tile is not connected to the others, and how it has a different pattern.

740032001.text: So... Why did we meet Narcissus in here?

740032003.text: According to what we said before, the tower lost its "time" and thus stagnated. As such, no one could open it or enter it.

740032004.text: But this space is not within the tower.

740032005.text: We teleported to a different place from the tower.

740032006.text: Huh, that's right! Paimon forgot that that happened... But if that's the case...

740032007.text: But how... No, that can't be true! The Princess should be in the tower. I mean, that was the adventure team's only hope in this dark world...

740032008.text: If she isn't... Our adventures... their meaning... Al, Petit Chou, and the others...

740032010.text: But we did take out the biggest threat to the kingdom, didn't we? That's a good thing, right?

740032011.text: ...Yes, you're right, Paimon. Thank you. Thank you both.

740032013.text: Yup! Look over there. There's a place we haven't been to before. Maybe we'll find more clues there, huh?

740034601.text: "... According to the ancient theater and mysterious research hidden here, we believe that the documents and folklore discovered within Petrichor..."

740034602.text: "...The research team from Institute of Natural Philosophy holds that..."

740034701.text: "...The duty will be taken up by Basil Elton, former naval commander. May her steely temper be itself tempered by the family she will establish with these children going forward..."

740034702.text: "... What's that idiot thinking? Well, whatever. Might as well have some fun post-retirement..."

740034801.text: "...One serving of flour, one of sugar, one of melted butter, two of eggs, a... large amount of milk with which to make foam. Are you kidding me? What exactly is 'a large amount'!? ..."

740034802.text: "...Remember it well this time! 15 minutes at 180 degrees is not the same as 5 at 540!"

740034901.text: "...Linking up with Ingold, Guillotin, and the rest of the old gang will go some way towards solving the dispersion problem. This situation is no place for personal feelings, but what person can lack them completely..."

740034902.text: "...I can only hope that they aren't treating my dear old Sponsian too poorly, or let it rust in the harbor..."

740034903.text: "...And I hope my skills haven't rusted away either."

740034904.text: "I hope all goes well. I still want to watch the dough rise to the sounds of play outside the window. I still want to watch them grow into fine adults."

740032602.text: What makes you think there'd be secret underground bookstore ruins anywhere in Fontaine?

740032603.text: Wait a minute. Is it just that Paimon hasn't fully woken up yet, or is it déjà vu? Haven't these things already happened before?

740032701.text: Hmm? There's a book here too...

740032702.text: A picture book, huh? It suits you, Paimon.

740032703.text: Hmph! Well, that's because of Paimon's unique sensibility, you know? Picture books just speak to her better!

740032704.text: This book... This book gives me a strange feeling.

740032706.text: "A long, long time ago, in a place far, far away, there was once a beautiful and kind Princess named Lyris... and yup, she's our main character!"

740032707.text: "'I don't want this name. That's not what you said before.'"

740032708.text: Do you wanna read it too, Ann? In that case, Paimon's gonna continue. Ahem!

740032709.text: "Oh, come on, it's just a story, there's no need to be so fussy. Anyway, a protagonist needs an antagonist... an evil one, at that!"

740032710.text: "And our evil antagonist... Well, that's the dragon Narcissus. So evil is he that the peace-loving people tremble at the sound of his name — not that he cares about their feelings, though."

740032711.text: "He sowed destruction across the land with the searing flames he spewed from his mouth. His great wings turned cities to dust and his burning breath reduced nations to ash."

740032714.text: "At last, only the Princess's realm remained safe."

740032715.text: "But because the Princess worked tirelessly to defend her realm, Narcissus's plot to destroy everything could not succeed."

740032716.text: "'So, in Narcissus's story, I'm the evil villain?'"

740032712.text: #This is kinda weird. This started like a story book, but it also feels like it isn't... {NICKNAME}, you've got the bigger brain here. You have a look too!

740031002.text: We already have the Holy Blade.

740031005.text: Wait, we really do have it. When did that happen?

740031006.text: Huh. You know what? Paimon thought that she hadn't fully woken up yet... But she definitely remembers that we came here before!

740030105.text: This place... This library has existed since long, long before we arrived.

740030106.text: Their contents seem to be ancient dramas. Children love to read books, but there is much they won't understand, so they will often ask adults to read the stories to them.

740030107.text: In the books, where there is an evil dragon, there must be heroes who hunt the dragon. If there is a mage, there must be a wandering knight. The Reconquista must come to pass, and the princess must be saved.

740030108.text: And of course, a chime will sound, and the tale of adventure will come to a halt.

740030109.text: Yet it will not end. There will be another adventure, and another, and another one after that, until the children grow up and leave this place.

740030111.text: Huh? I... Sorry, it felt like memories and feelings suddenly... flooded into my mind. How strange.

740030112.text: Huh. Well, as long as you're alright... Paimon thought you might have been bewitched by Narcissus's magic or something!

740030113.text: Urk. That might actually be so!

740030114.text: Hmmm... Well, what do we do next?

740030116.text: Whatever the case, let's have a look around.

740030117.text: Yup. First off... Huh, there's a door over there, but it looks like there's no way through it.

740030118.text: You two should be able to get across.

740030119.text: Hey, you're Ann's knight right now, you know. This will all be pointless if you don't come along!
